description: This file is a Bash script named 'pr_cycle.sh' that manages the review lifecycle (start, stop, clear) for components in a software project by updating dates in respective 'metadata.yaml' files. It provides command-line interface functionalities for initiating and ending review cycles, and clearing dates across components, primarily updating metadata and regenerating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Finds all components by locating 'metadata.yaml' files and listing their directories, excluding 'docs' and 'scripts'.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves and verifies the path to a component's 'metadata.yaml' file, exiting if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Calculates a date after adding a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Resets review date fields in the given 'metadata.yaml' file to a placeholder (~).

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Executes a script to regenerate the RAG status report.
